source.title: FCI128 King Charles Spaniel standard24.08.2021
source.paraphrase: Compact cobby toy spaniel with short straight forelegs. Skull domed and full above eyes; clearly defined stop; short upturned nose and broad deep square upturned muzzle. Low-set long feathered ears. Silky straight coat, pearly white tricolour ground with black patches, tan markings and wide blaze. Feathered tail stays at or below back level.

confirmedDefect: Existing skull dome and muzzle upturn insufficiently expressed; not conclusive evidence of a Cavalier identity.
